title: Low-level control
purpose: Locomotion, arm motion, and contact-based grasping under real dynamics.

requirements.title: Velocity-commanded locomotion
requirements.why: Walking is a learned low-level controller, not scripted kinematics

acceptance.text: walk(vx, vy, yaw_rate) commands the Unitree pretrained RL walking policy producing PD torques at 50 Hz
The walker contains no navigation, target-seeking, or task logic

requirements.title: Contact-based grasping replaces weld snaps
requirements.why: Fingers close on the prop and friction holds it; the object teleports for nobody

acceptance.text: With the arms driven by policy joint actions (no scripted IK reach), grasp(obj) closes the G1's three fingers on the object and holds it by contact forces only, with no equality weld activated
A grasped bowl survives a 0.3 m carry at 0.2 m/s and releases as a real drop under gravity
The executor source contains no code path that snaps an object between the palms

requirements.title: Self-correcting arm reach
requirements.why: The actuated free-base robot lags its IK plan; reaching must close the loop on measured position

acceptance.text: After each arm motion the executor re-reads the physical palm position and re-solves IK from the measured state before reporting failure
A scripted reach lands the palm within 5 cm of a counter-top target in under 10 simulated seconds
